title: Edit and extension remain separate ordered artifacts
prompt: Prepare the prompts for this ordered two-step job. First, edit @Video 1 so that only the blue umbrella held by the central adult becomes a red umbrella for the whole source; preserve every person, action, camera move, background, light and sound. Then append four seconds after that edited result: continue from its final frame as the same adult lowers the red umbrella and enters the doorway. The original source must not be edited and extended in one operation.
